title: Agent dispatch preflight: procedures and incident lessons
desc: How-to procedures for satisfying each of the 4 dispatch guards, plus 18 incident lessons from live delegation sessions. T2 howto tier of agent-dispatch-preflight.
steps: TODO: Guard 1 prevention (claude-md-sync-guard). WHEN: Guard fires if no Pending edit in last 30 turns. HOW: wkappbot skill read harness-agent-brief-guard, then Read CLAUDE.md, add Pending TODO, Edit, retry Agent(). WHY: blocks untracked AI work accumulation.

TODO: Guard 2 prevention (delegation guard). WHEN: your Agent() call is foreground. HOW: wkappbot skill read harness-agent-brief-guard to confirm run_in_background must be true. Then set run_in_background: true in the Agent tool call. WHY: Foreground Agent() blocks orchestrator output while invisible agent runs.

TODO: Guard 3 prevention (brief-guard). WHEN: brief lacks 3+ wkappbot skill reads or agent-on-load by name. HOW: wkappbot skill read harness-agent-brief-guard then prepend: wkappbot skill read agent-on-load, wkappbot skill read <model>-reflection, wkappbot skill read <domain-skill> before task description. WHY: serial rejections waste tokens; pre-load all requirements first attempt.

TODO: Guard 4 prevention (pace guard). WHEN: 5+ consecutive Edit/Bash calls. HOW: wkappbot skill read harness-pace-guard then stop direct tool calls, switch to Agent() with full task spec. WHY: pace prevents one actor monopolizing time; delegation resets counter.

DECISION: PRE-FLIGHT SEQUENCE. WHEN: before every Agent call. HOW: wkappbot skill read agent-dispatch-preflight then execute: (0) Read CLAUDE.md (1) Edit to add Pending (2) Confirm run_in_background true (3) Confirm prompt has 3+ skill reads+agent-on-load (4) Confirm prompt has Goal/Files/Approach/Constraints/Exit labels then fire. WHY: one careful brief beats three blocked retries.

DECISION: SPEC-GATE FORMAT for Opus Agent. WHEN: Opus-model Agent() dispatches. HOW: wkappbot skill read harness-tier-gate then format prompt as SPEC: description on own line, followed by numbered 1. Goal: 2. Files: 3. Approach: 4. Constraints: 5. Exit:. WHY: non-Opus skips this; Opus spec-gate gates it separately.

NAVIGATION: incident lessons and best practices from delegation. WHEN: after understanding the 4 guards above. HOW: wkappbot skill read agent-dispatch-preflight-ref for full failure-pattern story and PROVE-THE-ARTIFACT confabulation incident, then read agent-dispatch-preflight core for decision rules before any new delegation. WHY: layered three-tier reading prevents repeated gate refusals on fresh dispatches.
author: claude
